logistics.format: Web-based proctored, open-book reference (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: GCFA でオンプレ DFIR の基礎を持ったうえで、AWS/Azure/M365 のクラウド調査を評価する GCFR に進むと現代 DFIR の網羅性が高まる。

plus.note: クラウドログ/コントロールプレーン中心の DFIR 認証は希少で、現代 SOC/CSIRT に直結。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Cloud-log and control-plane investigation at three years supports professional response responsibility, reinforced by accreditation; open-book testing gives less evidence of live execution than a practical assessment.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Cloud log and control-plane forensics, accreditation and a three-year profile align well with professional MSSP response work. The open-book exam record does not specify a practical component, limiting confidence in independent live-cloud execution.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded cloud-log and control-plane investigations address a modern response surface at a three-year level. Accreditation and professional hints support delivery knowledge, while the record does not document a practical exam sufficient for a higher tier.
